name: file-upload
title: File upload
description: Takes files by drop or browse, shows each upload and what failed, then the attached files.

props.name: accept
props.description: As on `<input type="file">`: MIME types, `image/*` or extensions, comma separated.

props.name: dropTitle
props.description: Shown while files are dragged over the zone. Defaults to the `dropToUpload` label.

props.name: description
props.description: What the zone takes, e.g. "PDF, images, CSV · up to 10 MB".

props.name: onBrowse
props.description: Called instead of opening the file picker (demos, or an app that brings its own picker).

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Remove on an error row or a done chip.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Shows the drag-over look (state sheets, docs).

FileUploadItem.description: One file while it uploads or after it failed.
